title: Robotic Repair Intelligence — Overview and definition
t: Robotic Repair Intelligence — Overview and definition
description: Diagnoses machine failures and generates repair procedures and parts. (Proposed capability.)
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Diagnoses machine failures and generates repair procedures and parts. (Proposed capability.) A repair intelligence would diagnose faults from symptoms and sensor data, generate step-by-step repairs, and design replacement parts for printing. Diagnostic assistants are experimentally demonstrated in industry pilots. Status: experimentally-demonstrated. Capability status: PROPOSED. This database describes a proposed capability, not a completed product. Status taxonomy used throughout: speculative (no demonstrated path), simulated (works in simulation only), experimentally-demonstrated (lab demo exists), independently-verified (reproduced by a third party). Generating a design cannot make impossible physics possible; every record states which status its claims carry. Capability status for this tool: experimentally-demonstrated.

title: Robotic Repair Intelligence — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Diagnoses machine failures and generates repair procedures and parts. (Proposed capability.)
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Robotic Repair Intelligence, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Symptom-to-fault diagnosis). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Symptom-to-fault diagnosis and Repair-procedure generation. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Autonomous failure investigation system) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else. Capability status for this tool: experimentally-demonstrated.
